en: The maids here all put up with the work
for the sake of the high wages.
And the Baron even seems to enjoy watching
us play his games against our will.
He really is an odd one.
Excuse me, is anyone home?
Oh, coming! Who is it?
D-d-don't tell me the Baron sent you?
Sorry, I'm feeling poorly today...
Oh, you gave me a fright.
I was sure it was a messenger
from the Baron.
If it had been, I was going to
pretend I was sick.
Oh, what is it?
I'm worn out from work every day.
Unless it's important, I can't hear you out.
I need whatever rest I can get.
Oh, it's you. Hello.
We'd be glad if you'd visit the Baron's
manor instead. What do you say?
All of us servants would welcome you there.
We're all fed up with the Baron's whims,
so talking with someone sensible is
a relief.
Coming! Oh, good evening.
I came to offer you
a new position...
Huh?
I trust it will be to your liking?
W-why, certainly.
Compared to working for the Baron...
Then bear with it, just for a moment.
What?!
Wh-
note: #9314-#9320 have no used_in (after the bite); layout unknown, written to read both on one line and across a break.

en: What are you doing?!
How do you find it?
Your new station,
as my servant.
I may be a less amusing employer than your
Baron, but that hardly matters, does it?
Hahahaha...
...What a restless girl.
If I'm late for work again, who knows
what they'll make me do! I'm so worried!
Good morning. Looks like I'll just make it
to work in time today. What a relief.
I believe you dropped your handkerchief.
Oh? There are more all over...
Hm? There's something written on this.
These say some rather amusing things.
Whatever are these?
She really does seem to have it hard.
I almost feel sorry for her.
I mean, the Baron hired me as a cook,
I just thought I'd drop by.
...Is the Baron well?
Yes, as you'll see for yourself,
I see. I'm glad he's well.
every now and then, really.
Dear me, what a thing to say.
Well, I'll come again.
Is the Baron well?
Well, I shall call again another time.
servants company. Sorry about that.
It seems you've even been playing along
with the Baron's games. I'm so sorry.
Another time, please.
As it is, I still have to think up
a dish the Baron will like...
If it's something I can do,
just say the word...
The name's Martha.
This here's the factory where we make glue.
You know what gelatine is?
Here we boil down animal bones and sinew
to make that gelatine stuff.
See, gelatine's what glue is made from.
After working here, you end up sticky
all over.
